lines: What if all the air on Earth vanished, right now?
The sky goes black, even at noon.
Your ears pop. The spit on your tongue starts to boil.
Planes and birds drop out of the sky. Every fire goes out.
Myth: your body explodes. Nope. Your skin holds you together.
You'd stay awake for about ten seconds. Five is survivable.
Then the air slams back. Boom.
So, would you hold your breath, or breathe out?
Breathe out. Holding it can rupture your lungs.
